description: SEC-2 (F30): the only environment variables a project MCP registry file (someone else's commit) may read with ${VAR}. Each is non-secret by design; any other name reads as its written default or empty. A personal (local/user) file is the owner's own and reads its environment unrestricted.
trustMaxBytesNote: The largest trust record read (256 servers x 512 pins fit well below it); a larger file is refused unread.
